# Prayer for the Soul (Tefila La-Neshama)

> A free, in-browser tool that builds a printable Hebrew memorial prayer
> sheet - Tehillim (Psalms), Kaddish, Mishnayot and Hashkava/Yizkor - for
> reading at the cemetery or sharing with family. The wizard runs entirely
> client-side: the finished sheet is turned into a PDF by a layout engine
> compiled to WebAssembly, in the visitor's own browser. No document content
> is ever sent to a server, and the site has no tracking or analytics.

## Pages

- [Home](https://izkor.example/): the prayer-sheet wizard.
- [About](https://izkor.example/about): who built the site and why.
- [Blog](https://izkor.example/blog): notes on how the site and its tools work.
- [Contact](https://izkor.example/contact): get in touch with the author.
- [Accessibility statement](https://izkor.example/accessibility)
- [Privacy policy](https://izkor.example/privacy)

English versions of every page above are available under the `/en` prefix,
e.g. https://izkor.example/en, https://izkor.example/en/blog.
